app_config_values_shape_check.name: app_config_values_shape_check
app_config_values_shape_check.value: ("cantelop_control"."app_config_values"."kind" = 'variable' AND "cantelop_control"."app_config_values"."value_text" IS NOT NULL AND "cantelop_control"."app_config_values"."secret_nonce" IS NULL AND "cantelop_control"."app_config_values"."secret_ciphertext" IS NULL) OR ("cantelop_control"."app_config_values"."kind" = 'secret' AND "cantelop_control"."app_config_values"."value_text" IS NULL AND octet_length("cantelop_control"."app_config_values"."secret_nonce") = 12 AND octet_length("cantelop_control"."app_config_values"."secret_ciphertext") >= 16)

deployment_uploads_session_runtime_store.name: deployment_uploads_session_runtime_store_upload_id_check
deployment_uploads_session_runtime_store.value: "cantelop_control"."deployment_uploads"."session_runtime_store_upload_id" IS NULL OR (length("cantelop_control"."deployment_uploads"."session_runtime_store_upload_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 AND "cantelop_control"."deployment_uploads"."session_runtime_store_upload_id" !~ '[\x00\r\n]')

deployment_uploads_preparing_check.name: deployment_uploads_preparing_check
deployment_uploads_preparing_check.value: "cantelop_control"."deployment_uploads"."status" <> 'preparing' OR ("cantelop_control"."deployment_uploads"."session_runtime_store_upload_id" IS NULL AND "cantelop_control"."deployment_uploads"."session_runtime_part_size_bytes" IS NULL AND "cantelop_control"."deployment_uploads"."session_runtime_part_count" IS NULL)

deployment_uploads_uploaded_check.name: deployment_uploads_uploaded_check
deployment_uploads_uploaded_check.value: "cantelop_control"."deployment_uploads"."status" NOT IN ('uploading', 'finalized') OR ("cantelop_control"."deployment_uploads"."session_runtime_store_upload_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cantelop_control"."deployment_uploads"."session_runtime_part_size_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "cantelop_control"."deployment_uploads"."session_runtime_part_count" IS NOT NULL)

operations_running_check.name: operations_running_check
operations_running_check.value: ("cantelop_control"."operations"."status" = 'running') = ("cantelop_control"."operations"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "cantelop_control"."operations"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL)
